_comment: Example only. Copy to the application folder as appsettings.Production.json and replace the placeholders. Contains no secrets: SQL Server is reached with the app-pool Windows identity.

Auth._comment: Forms = account name + password held by the hub (first administrator via the one-time setup code in SetupCodeFile; HTTPS required). Windows = Negotiate through IIS with BootstrapAdministrators and group mappings.

DataProtection._comment: Full path outside the application folder, for example D:\TioHubKeys. Empty = keys in %ProgramData%\TioHub\DataProtection-Keys, which is enough for one server. Set it when several servers share this database. Restrict the folder to the app-pool identity and administrators, and back it up. See docs/JIRA_SECURITY_AND_DEPLOYMENT.md.
